# Schedule editor (`schedule-editor`)

A week of time blocks, each with a value (a temperature, on or off), drawn as rows you drag to shape.

Group: Home controls. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/home';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createScheduleEditor` (types in `dist/web/home/climate-energy/scheduleEditor.d.ts`): `.mh-schedule`: a week (or any set of days) of time blocks, one row per day on a 24-hour track, each block with avalue from `levels`. Drag to shape, tap to change, or use the keys on a focused block; every change calls`onChange` with all the days. The web handle keeps its own days.

```ts
export function createScheduleEditor(options: ScheduleEditorOptions): ScheduleEditorHandle;

export interface ScheduleEditorOptions {
  /** The accessible name ("Heating schedule"). */
  label: string;
  /** Usually seven, Monday or Sunday first as the app likes. */
  days: readonly ScheduleDay[];
  /** The values a block can take; a new block takes the first. */
  levels: readonly ScheduleLevel[];
  /** What the gaps mean ("17°", "Off"), shown in the legend after "Otherwise". */
  base?: string;
  /** Snap of every time, in minutes (default 15). */
  step?: number;
  /** Length of a block added by tapping or with the add button, in minutes (default 60). */
  length?: number;
  /** Marks the time now on its day. */
  now?: { day: number; minute: number };
  disabled?: boolean;
  labels?: Partial<ScheduleEditorLabels>;
  /** Called with every day after each change (dragging, keys, taps). */
  onChange?: (days: ScheduleDay[]) => void;
}

export interface ScheduleEditorHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  getDays(): ScheduleDay[];
  setDays(days: readonly ScheduleDay[]): void;
  update(options: ScheduleEditorOptions): void;
  destroy(): void;
}

/** Every visible and spoken word, for translation. */
export interface ScheduleEditorLabels {
  /** Before the base value in the legend ("Otherwise"). */
  otherwise: string;
  /** Name of a day's add button, before the day ("Add a block on"). */
  add: string;
  /** Joins the two times of a block ("06:30 to 08:00"). */
  to: string;
  /** Spoken how-to for a focused block. */
  help: string;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createScheduleEditor, type ScheduleDay } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

// Times are minutes after midnight.
const workday = [
  { start: 6 * 60 + 30, end: 8 * 60, value: 'comfort' },
  { start: 17 * 60, end: 22 * 60, value: 'comfort' },
];
const weekend = [{ start: 8 * 60, end: 23 * 60, value: 'comfort' }];

const days: ScheduleDay[] = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'].map((label, i) => ({
  label,
  blocks: i < 5 ? workday : weekend,
}));

const schedule = createScheduleEditor({
  label: 'Living room heating',
  days,
  levels: [
    { value: 'comfort', label: '21°' },
    { value: 'eco', label: '18°' },
  ],
  base: '16°',
  onChange: (next) => console.log('Save the schedule', next),
});

document.body.append(schedule.el);
```

## React API

`ScheduleEditor` (types in `dist/react/home-climate-energy.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createScheduleEditor`. Controlled: render the days from `onChange` back into `days`. Focus follows the block a key press, tap or drag left selected.

```ts
export function ScheduleEditor({ className, ...options }: ScheduleEditorProps);

export interface ScheduleEditorProps extends ScheduleEditorOptions {
  className?: string;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { ScheduleEditor } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';
import type { ScheduleDay } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

// Times are minutes after midnight.
const WORKDAY = [
  { start: 6 * 60 + 30, end: 8 * 60, value: 'comfort' },
  { start: 17 * 60, end: 22 * 60, value: 'comfort' },
];
const WEEKEND = [{ start: 8 * 60, end: 23 * 60, value: 'comfort' }];
const WEEK: ScheduleDay[] = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri', 'Sat', 'Sun'].map((label, i) => ({
  label,
  blocks: i < 5 ? WORKDAY : WEEKEND,
}));
const LEVELS = [
  { value: 'comfort', label: '21°' },
  { value: 'eco', label: '18°' },
];

export function ScheduleEditorExample() {
  const [days, setDays] = useState(WEEK);
  return (
    <ScheduleEditor label="Living room heating" days={days} levels={LEVELS} base="16°" onChange={setDays} />
  );
}
```
